english.title: Person under 18 years of age possess an adult firework
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person under the age of 18 had in your possession a **(..SPECIFY THE FIREWORK..) being an adult firework as defined in regulation 3 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 4 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004 and section 11(2) and (4) of the Fireworks Act 2003.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The issuing of Penalty Notices for Disorder for this offence was discontinued as from 08/04/13.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Unigolyn dan 18 oed yn meddu ar dân gwyllt i oedolyn.
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) a chithau'n unigolyn dan 18 oed, roedd gennych yn eich meddiant **(..SPECIFY THE FIREWORK..) a oedd yn dân gwyllt i oedolyn fel y'i diffinnir yn rheoliad 3 Rheoliadau Tân Gwyllt 2004.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i reoliad 4 Rheoliadau Tân Gwyllt 2004 ac adran 11(1) a (4) Deddf Tân Gwyllt 2003.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months (see regulation 13 of the Fireworks Regulations 2004)

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
